## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.7`

### Features

- send from the compose bar to the broadcast targets, insert saved commands into it, and suggest from history: a command for several hosts still had to go through the broadcast panel, and a saved one went straight into the terminal; with broadcast targets picked, the bar can now send to them all, at once as the panel does or line by line with a run in each connected target, the command library inserts a command into the bar on a line of its own to be looked over and sent from there, and typing a command shows the newest recent one it begins in grey, taken with Right or End ([843d3dac](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/843d3dacb1c0d0e9e3a097087e143ca88782a1c9))
- let the compose bar run several lines one at a time: pasted at once, a line that reads its input, such as a Y/n question or a password prompt, took the lines after it as answers, and a failed command did not stop the rest; with Line by line ticked, the next line now goes only once the shell is back at its prompt (OSC 133), a command that exits non-zero holds the rest until Retry, Continue or Stop, and the bar shows each line's progress, which goes on while another pane has the bar; the shell has to mark its prompts, so a shell without shell integration, or one still running a command, says so and what to turn on instead of sending ([428aaeda](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/428aaeda3755f99fa1ef744c30218a1aa947944a))
- add a compose bar that sends a whole command at once: over a slow link even with typing shown ahead, every key still went to the server; a command is now typed into a bar below the panes, where editing waits on nothing, and Enter sends it to the focused pane in one go through the terminal's own input, so it is recorded, timed and broadcast like a typed one; several lines go in as one paste where the shell takes bracketed paste, Up and Down recall recent commands, Ctrl+C with nothing selected interrupts the running command, and Esc goes back to the terminal; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+. (iTerm2's composer key) or the terminal's context menu shows it, and a serial tab keeps its own send bar ([f2fc39b5](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f2fc39b5962ab5494ab8e358adf91b5632d2d507))
- show typing at a remote shell before its echo comes back: over a slow link, such as a chain of jump hosts, every key waited a round trip before it showed; plain typing and backspace at the end of the shell's line are now drawn at once over the terminal, mosh style, and the server's echo confirms or takes them back, without touching the terminal's content; a line shows guesses only once the server has echoed a key typed on it, so a password prompt never shows what is typed, and full-screen programs, programs that hide the cursor and mouse-reporting programs are left alone; Settings → Connection → Typing turns it on automatically above a measured round trip of 30 ms by default (10-2000 ms, off again below two thirds of it), always, or never ([f543c04e](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f543c04eef4b3aeaabf777add4d02b376f5c4f04))
- reuse a jump host that is already connected: a hop another connection logged in to, or a host a terminal tab is connected to, now carries the next connection that jumps through it over the same route, so a bastion is not logged in to, nor its one-time code typed, again; connections to the same hop wait for one login, as restored tabs behind one bastion do, a tab closing keeps its session for the connections still on it, and the connection test keeps its sessions to itself ([295cc78a](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/295cc78a7032b518adeb6d0ff3a28e8d878108eb))
- let a jump host log in as one of the saved connections: each hop of the chain can now be picked from the saved SSH connections instead of typed in, and keeps only the connection's id, so the hop goes where that connection points and logs in the way it does, with its saved password, even after it changes; a copy of its address stays for display and for older versions, a deleted connection says which hop to fix, and the picked connection's own jump hosts aren't followed ([d4a555db](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/d4a555db39398efbaa46247d39959ddb6613eeb0))
- list each WSL distribution as its own local shell: the new tab list, the settings and the connection dialog offered only WSL's default, so a second distribution took a custom shell to reach; the distributions are read from the registry rather than wsl -l, whose UTF-16 output and localized default marker are easy to misread, and one can be made the default shell ([0a7eba1c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/0a7eba1c28a658dbc9421db631a0d56db6620089))

### Fixes

- keep the open settings section when the settings tab is left and come back to: a page tab unmounts while out of sight, so the section picked, such as Groups, was lost with the panel and it opened on General again; the section is now kept on the tab and the panel opens on it ([bc70b9c3](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/bc70b9c384697544acea5f0016f1301bdb96302e))
- keep the password typed for a saved-connection jump host when a tunnel is told to remember it: the credentials dialog asked for it with Save in secure storage, but only typed-in hops were saved, so an automatic tunnel through such a hop asked again at every start; it is now saved as that connection's password ([e418bfb2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e418bfb25ec99c450b721da01c17fbb998666125))
- log in to a jump host afresh when its shared session does not carry the connection: a session found open was used as it was, so one left half dead by sleep or a network change held a reconnect until its keepalive gave up, and one whose login may not forward failed every connection through it for as long as it stayed open; opening a channel through a shared session now gets ten seconds, and when it fails the session leaves the pool and the chain is logged in to again, the new sessions taking its place ([fc30b2cc](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/fc30b2cc4bb5e1ba4871945685b2a4ff1a052422))
- bring the typing guess settings into range when the config is read: a threshold out of range or with a fraction, written by hand or synced from elsewhere, failed the whole config file to load, and any mode was taken; the threshold is now rounded and kept within 10-2000 ms, and an unknown mode reads as auto, as the frontend already does ([81cfc4ab](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/81cfc4ab096997f4de4fc275686083096725257e))
- guess typing again once a terminal reset shows the cursor: whether the cursor showed was followed only from the sequences that show and hide it, so after a full-screen program died with the cursor hidden, Reset terminal (DECSTR) or a remote reset (RIS) brought the cursor back but the tab never guessed again; it now reads xterm's own record, which a reset also clears, and the sequences, still followed where that can't be read, are told apart with subparameters too ([3228902c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3228902c85e60f66380a73bd0cbbb22833c8f552))
- keep a saved command's confirmation when it is put in the compose bar: a command set to ask before it runs was inserted into the bar without asking, on the grounds that it waited there to be sent, and could then go to every broadcast target without a word; sending from the bar now asks first, naming the commands, until the bar is sent or emptied ([c55bb1e4](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c55bb1e4e90312b7dc5209d14d3abebfeaaca9f9))
- ask before the compose bar runs its lines one by one in the broadcast targets: sent at once to them, several lines asked first, as the broadcast panel does, but a line-by-line run started in every target without asking; it now says how many commands will run in how many terminals and waits for the go-ahead ([451924db](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/451924db6c79016bd7a004f194d5b0c20c2c2cb3))
- keep Ctrl+D in the compose bar an edit key on macOS: there it deletes forward in a text field, and once the text was gone the next press sent EOF and ended the shell; the bar now sends EOF from an empty bar only on Windows and Linux ([e6a1239b](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e6a1239b8367dcc375e92c241a461ea6e23cec3c))
- run a command that goes on over several lines as one step of a line-by-line run: a line ending in a backslash, an open quote, a here-document or a block such as if … fi, for … done, case … esac or a braced one was sent a line at a time, which left the shell at its continuation prompt, where no prompt is marked, and the run waited there for good; the lines of one command now go together, blank lines inside it kept, and the shell gives one prompt for them ([473ef42d](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/473ef42d931b10fe8f9f2db8332e23bbba6187dd))
- ask for a jump host's password when none is saved: a hop that logs in as a saved connection keeping no password, or a typed-in hop whose password wasn't kept, failed at once with "password is required" and nowhere to type it; a password login with nothing stored now asks in the login prompt, naming the hop, as the step after a partial login already did, and a background connection that can't show a prompt says so ([f8496396](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f84963964373a7c3232fd4dd44431172f574a75e))
- send a line-by-line run's next line only once the shell has run the one before: any prompt counted as the running line's end, so Enter pressed in the terminal while a line ran, which the shell answers with a prompt of its own before reading the next line, or a prompt drawn again, sent the line after early, into the running one as its input; a shell that marks where its commands start now has to have started one since its last prompt, a comment still ends at the next prompt, and a line the shell can't parse fails with its status instead of the run waiting for good ([ea9bf1f7](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/ea9bf1f7630c6d3e68f8338c2f8c3502244aeb86))
- stop the compose bar asking the multi-line paste question during live broadcast: it sends a line and its Enter in one write, which the input took for a paste, so every line it sent, and each line of a line-by-line run, asked before it went; a line the bar sends with its Enter now counts as typed, while text of several lines from it, and a paste that ends in a line break, still ask ([3b3114bf](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3b3114bfa915185d40ea429817b0ba7cf6f13841))
- stop macOS autocorrect in the broadcast command box, the tab search and the SFTP delete command: these fields were plain elements rather than the shared Input and Textarea, so WebKit offered to capitalize a typed command, turning ll into Ll; they now turn off autocapitalize, autocorrect, autocomplete and spellcheck, and the SFTP delete command uses the shared Textarea, which also drops its old offset focus ring ([2abdeb4c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/2abdeb4cf7d89b3f417f19869119f07f4eef7355))
- stop a pane flashing empty as it is resized: resizing clears the WebGL canvas at once while xterm draws it again only on the next frame, so opening or closing the compose bar, or any bar beside a pane, showed one frame blank; a fit that changes the size now draws every row at once ([9f17afa9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/9f17afa9d3c8c8d169a33527d269cf05a33900f0))
- find an imported shell that is already here by its program, and give a new id only under beta.7's default: importing the same backup again gave its shell another new id each time and added it again, and a shell edited on one device came in beside this device's own copy instead of leaving it as it is here ([b279a420](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/b279a4207f16e94a1fd9036d81a2074e7dc3f4ef))
- key each WSL distribution by its name alone and keep WSL hidden for users of v0.7.2-beta.7: the default distribution took the key wsl while WSL's default was the default shell, so hiding it then hid WSL as a whole and changing the default showed it again; WSL's own default now shows as an entry of its own while it is the default, which also marks it when the registry names no default distribution, and a hidden wsl from beta.7, which matched none of the distributions, hides each of them ([fd23ecb8](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/fd23ecb8650b2f1cc7eeb1294156646ba2383e7f))
- fail to start a WSL tab whose distribution isn't installed: wsl.exe started, said so and exited, which isn't a failed start, so a restored tab or a connection with a removed distribution never showed the bar that offers another shell; a registry that lists no distribution leaves the decision to wsl.exe ([7607b750](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/7607b75039b57575c1012bc40259bc959008c0c9))
- keep this device's default shell when an imported one is a built-in shell it doesn't have: only a missing WSL distribution gave way, so pwsh or WSL from a Windows backup stayed the default on macOS and Linux, which start the login shell instead and then marked no shell as the default ([df6ba3e1](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/df6ba3e1559961699749faf1ebad7fdcb9ba0a58))
- bring an imported shell in under an id of its own when this device uses its id for another program: v0.7.2-beta.7 gave every migrated shell the id default, so a backup between two devices that came from it still dropped the other device's shell as already there; changing the id on import leaves the id saved tabs carry alone ([c1c4862d](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c1c4862debb8a9370c306d23e21d1b52a8dfe1d2))
- build the WSL distribution fields only on Windows: only the Windows shell reads them, so clippy failed the macOS and Linux builds on a field that was never read; serde drops the frontend's value there as an unknown field ([0afb3c6c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/0afb3c6ca1962eb67186b3368a3655cc5d05f194))
- give a migrated custom shell an id from its program instead of default: every device that came from an older version gave its own one the same id, so a backup from one device dropped its shell on another as already there, even when the two were different programs ([00e9459c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/00e9459c486819d7eeb0d72c7ea80710443dff8e))
- try a failed local tab's shell as it is saved now: Try again started the path and arguments the tab opened with, so fixing the shell in the settings didn't reach a tab that had already failed with it ([b4449e4c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/b4449e4cbec8d21b9085f09f9da6ce9ef23f7c25))
- offer Auto when a local tab's default shell is the one that failed to start: the bar hid its way out for the default, so a broken default left only Try again, and Edit for a shell of the user's own ([e5017219](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e501721937d1e1af54ed9e8348abd914b6e73fda))

### UI and usability

- give the broadcast panel's command box and input picker a single focus frame: an offset outline was drawn around a border that also turned the ring color, so a focused field showed two frames; the fields now show focus with their own border alone, without the outline or a halo, which looked heavy on a box this large ([92e92a5e](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/92e92a5e285e09d6299464998b91ace5e5aae68b))
- name a WSL tab after its distribution: every distribution's tab was titled WSL until its shell reported a directory, and its tooltip said WSL too; the shell's name stays WSL, as dropped paths and tab icons go by it ([58e692b6](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/58e692b69ebe6cb77814e268ee9fa0e463c360e3))

### Security

- keep typed characters hidden at a password prompt that masks with *: with sudo-rs or pwfeedback the line stopped looking like a prompt after the first *, and the echo of a backspace, which a masked prompt erases its * with, or a * in the password, counted as the shell echoing typing, so the keys after it were drawn in clear text until their * came back; a backspace's echo no longer shows that a line echoes, a line that echoed a key as another character shows nothing more until Enter, Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D, and a line where a password prompt was seen stays out of bounds until it ends ([f589e57a](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f589e57ad0c41fd65a9034e6399497ee3417be9b))

**Full comparison:** [v0.7.2-beta.7...v0.7.2-beta.8](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/compare/v0.7.2-beta.7...v0.7.2-beta.8)
